finding: The native sidepanel harness used WEB_ORIGIN in the page_create traffic marker without declaring it. A popup scratch driver supplied an ambient global, masking the startup error.
fix: Declare the canonical web origin in the harness before the traffic marker calls.

verification.red: node --test tests/browser/native-sidepanel-origin.test.mjs failed with ReferenceError: WEB_ORIGIN is not defined before the fix
verification.green: The same test passed after the fix and confirmed traffic labels for https://www.aimatrx.com and https://server.app.matrxserver.com
verification.scope: The focused page_create block was executed without ambient globals; the full native browser startup was not run in this lane.
